lens:
RED TEAM PRE-MORTEM of READER-2 and the intraday lane (design-redteam, workflow edge-swings).

Every figure comes from a script in ~/Work/.ltcm-main/goal-2026-10-19/evl10/redteam/ or from the facts files. All of it is synthetic or outcome-free.

THE VERDICT:

1. READER-2 has the better expected value per false-pass charge. It can enter as FREE RECORDS. EVL-8's meta-learner weighs those as program experts at zero charge (EVL-8 s7.2 makes every hold-1 record a SOURCE). Seated, it trades at auctions, where fills cost ~0. The intraday seat must first earn the widened half-spread plus the 10 bp margin.
   - Under stated priors (ev10.out), true promotions per 0.13 charge: 0.068 for READER-2 vs 0.036 for intraday.
   - Net over 120 sessions: +$17.6 vs +$0.3.

2. The intraday lane is cheaper per metered dollar (~$0/day: it reuses the day-news verdicts, and quotes are on the free plan). But its expected money is about 0, so the ratio says nothing.

3. The most likely six-week failure for BOTH swings is the frozen clock, not the idea. PREREG-EVL-6 makes no look before block 22. A real +40 bp edge is still unpromoted at session 30 with probability 0.83-0.90, and a real +60 bp edge with probability 0.64-0.80 (screen10.power).

4. The scarcest input is the false-pass budget. After EVL-6 to -9, LEFT is 0.78 (6 charges), or 0.39 (3) once A104's births register (budget10.out).

THE DESIGN: RT-10.
- Register every rule free first; seat at most one program per file, and only while 0.39 stays free.
- READER-2:
  - reads only the slot subset: $0.572/day in earnings season, $0.203/day after;
  - pins the model string and runs daily canaries;
  - a late read counts as missing for shadow and money alike;
  - six free records feed META.
- Intraday:
  - starts as a free CENSUS with no orders;
  - its one seat (IOC at the IEX ask x 1.003, exit at the close cross, replay at the SIP ask plus COST-7, a settled-cash guard, its own switch) is registered BY RULE only when the census's ex-ante cost facts pass a gate. It lapses at the census's 40th session.
design:
A. THE PRE-MORTEM. Assume that six weeks from now (about 30 sessions) both swings lost money or found nothing. The causes are ranked, each with its guard.

C1 THE CLOCK (both swings): no look before the 22nd block.
- Power under the frozen screen, base cell (screen10.power, 1,000 programs a cell). P(promoted by session 30) / within 120 sessions, at 5 / 8 / 14 events a session:
  - +20 bp: .036/.048, .057/.064, .062/.067;
  - +30 bp: .084/.103, .083/.100, .112/.129;
  - +40 bp: .105/.137, .148/.171, .174/.194;
  - +60 bp: .198/.264, .265/.333, .357/.418.
- A READER-2 top-K seat at the reader lens's dispersion (s_mu 0.4%, a -10 bp population mean, 165 candidates; topk_edge.out) has these edges and pass rates within 120 sessions (screen10.topk):
  - top 8: 14.5 / 26.6 / 38.7 bp at rho .30 / .45 / .60, passing .046 / .092 / .160;
  - top 14: 11.7 / 22.6 / 33.3 bp, passing .040 / .079 / .142.
- Guard: none inside the frozen screen. Read the census, RS-1 and learning P&L at six weeks, never promotions. Spend no charge while waiting (RT-0).

C2 HFT PRICED THE ITEM (intraday). Articles are knowable at created_at + 2 min and 8-Ks at acceptance + 10 min (PREREG-EVL-1 s3).
- Created to order at the venue, from the code's timers (latency10.out):
  - p50 172 s and p90 226 s at today's 2-minute record pass;
  - p50 87 s and p90 128 s with a new file's knowable = stored time and a 30 s poll.
- Positive reports are priced within about a minute (Busse and Green 2002, JFE 65(3)). HFTs trade in the direction of permanent price changes (Brogaard, Hendershott and Riordan 2014, RFS 27(8)).
- Guard:
  - no move-conditioned trigger;
  - skip an IEX ask more than 3% above the SIP last trade 16 minutes earlier (the attention-reversal side: Berkman, Koch, Tuttle and Zhang 2012, JFQA 47(4));
  - no 8-Ks.

C3 READER-2 ADDS COST WITHOUT INFORMATION.
- v1 is already an LLM, and PREREG-EVL-7 has already taken READER-2's free signals (16 keyword flags and dup72).
- Predictability sits mostly in negative news and small stocks (Lopez-Lira and Tang 2023, arXiv:2304.07619).
- Cost and break-even edge, on one learning seat / two streams / Probe (reader_cost10.out):
  | variant | $/day | break-even (bp) | A102 sessions of Done time |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | the reader lens's sketch | 0.881 | 29.0 / 14.5 / 9.3 | 5.3 |
  | Sonnet 5.5 on the whole R2 set | 2.649 | 87.1 / 43.6 / 27.9 | 15.9 |
  | Opus 5.5 on the whole R2 set | 5.297 | 174.3 / 87.1 / 55.7 | 31.8 |
- Measurement cannot police the spend within a season (futility10.out). After 60 sessions of 30 hash events, a forward IC test:
  - shows a better reader (rho .45 vs .30) better only 0.32 of the time;
  - stops a worse one (.20) only 0.197 of the time.
- Guard (RT-R.1):
  - read only the slot subset: Haiku on the top 40 news plus a 1/16 hash sample; Sonnet 5.5 only on the top 24 earnings 8-Ks;
  - no cascade, no Opus;
  - $0.572/day in earnings season, $0.203/day after;
  - break-even 9.4 bp on two streams, 6.0 bp at Probe;
  - plus RT-R.4's spend stop.

C4 THE SPREAD THE AUCTIONS NEVER PAID (intraday).
- All 84 auction fills printed at the replay price (EXECUTION-FACTS).
- At 172 s the half-spread paid is (intraday_exec.out):
  | pre-news half-spread h0 | no widening | x2 widening | x3 widening |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | 8 bp | 8.0 | 12.5 | 17.0 |
  | 15 bp | 15.0 | 23.5 | 31.9 |
  | 30 bp | 30.0 | 46.9 | 63.8 |
- Residual drift to the close needed for the 10 bp margin / for +60 bp judged: 22.8 / 72.8 bp at h0 8 and x2, 57.2 / 107.2 bp at h0 30.
- THE TRAP: drift is left in slow, illiquid names (Hou and Moskowitz 2005, RFS 18(3)), and those are the wide-spread names.
- Guard: the cost filter plus RT-I.3's gate (median SIP half-spread at the order <= 10 bp) before any seat exists.

C5 THE BUDGET CROWDS OUT.
- LEFT is 0.78 now, 0.39 after A104. EVL-6's second runs are owed 1.95 if none passes.
- One seat takes 17-33% of LEFT; two seats take 67% after A104 (budget10.out).
- Guard (RT-0, RT-R.5): rules become free records and META sources; at most one seat, kept only while 0.39 stays free.

C6 A MIS-COSTED INTRADAY REPLAY.
- A shadow at the mid or last print, while money pays the ask. A money-null overstated by h passes within 120 sessions (screen10.bias, 2,000 a cell), base / worst cell at 8 a session:
  | h | base | worst |
  |---|---|---|
  | 10 bp | .037 | .091 |
  | 20 bp | .063 | .141 |
  | 30 bp | .106 | .185 |
  | 45 bp | .202 | .248 |
- A mid-based Done gap equals h_eff: 12.5-63.8 bp.
- Guard (RT-I.2): replay at the SIP NBBO ask at the send + 2 s; the shadow fills only what that ask allows; COST-7's ratchets apply. The fill gap is then about 0 bp (-0.03 to +0.02).

C7 JUDGED IS NOT TRADED VIA LATE READS (READER-2).
- The sketch's shadow waits for late reads; money skips them.
- Guard: a read after 09:12 ET is missing for both. No cascade.

C8 DRIFT BEHIND 'claude-sonnet-5-5' (an undated id in CLAUDE_MODELS).
- Behaviour drifts behind stable names (Chen, Zaharia and Zou 2023, arXiv:2307.09009). json_schema through the gateway is untested.
- Guard (RT-R.3):
  - pin the response's model string;
  - 12 synthetic canaries, about $0.04/day;
  - a two-session stop trigger;
  - the R2-J fallback.

C9 PLUMBING (intraday).
- The gateway takes event buys only as opg/cls (caps.mjs EVENT_TIFS).
- The lane is one slot of 60 s turns.
- The whole trading window is inside the deploy-blocked window.
- Cash-account good-faith violations: live.py sizes from account cash, which includes the open's unsettled proceeds (Alpaca forum staff answer, Aug 14 2024).
- Settled cash after the open funds 12-32 learning lots but only 6-18 Probe lots against 14 (settled_cash10.out).
- Guard: settled-cash cap, a separate switch, ROOM after A85's close reservations, no send after 14:45 ET, a day stop on any refusal.

C10 LIMIT-FILL ADVERSE SELECTION AND KNOB MULTIPLICITY.
- A resting bid is a free option to the next informed trader (Copeland and Galai 1983, JF 38(5); Linnainmaa 2010, JF 65(4)).
- Passive minus marketable, per attempt, at h0 8-15 (passive_select.out):
  - -4.7 to -27.1 bp in every cell when the order queues at the bid;
  - -8.7 to +37.2 bp when a touch counts as a fill.
- Guard: IOC only; exit at the cross; one seat; every variant is a census field.

C11 SEASON.
- Earnings records thin after mid-November.
- v1's $1 reserve makes READER-2 yield on heavy days.
- Guard: the seat is news-based; the subset's count is fixed.

C12 GATEWAY CAPS: not binding (at most 16 orders a session against the 150 / 250 / 300 lines).

B. THE DESIGN (the prereg_clauses field gives the text to freeze). RT-0 zero charge first.
- READER-2:
  - RT-R.1: the slot subset;
  - RT-R.2: late = missing;
  - RT-R.3: pin and canaries;
  - RT-R.4: the spend stop;
  - RT-R.5: six free records inside decide-open:<D> (META sources);
  - RT-R.6: one seat, EVL-R2-NEWS-TOP14-O1;
  - RT-R.7: META headroom.
- Intraday:
  - RT-I.1: the free census;
  - RT-I.2: the seat text;
  - RT-I.3: registration by an ex-ante cost gate;
  - RT-I.4: never.

C. EXPECTED VALUE (ev10.py; the priors are stated in the calibration field), over 120 sessions:
| | true promotions per charge | false promotions (base / worst null) | E[P&L] | metered | net |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| READER-2 seat | 0.068 | 0.008 / 0.046 | +$55.3 | $37.7 | +$17.6 |
| intraday seat | 0.036 | 0.007 / 0.035 | +$0.3 | $0 | +$0.3 |
- READER-2 as records costs 0 charges. Its money comes only through META's runs (EVL-8 s0: a +40 / +60 bp sub-rule is found 0.207 / 0.657 of the time within 120 sessions).
- Order of work: READER-2 first. The intraday census now, for free. The intraday seat only when the facts open the gate.
why_it_compounds:
(1) The false-pass budget is the binding input: LEFT is 0.39-0.78, with births and second runs owed out of it. RT-0 spends none of it on what can be a record. READER-2's records become EVL-8 META program experts by that file's own SOURCES rule, so the hill-climber weighs them forward with no charge and no captain step. Every later reader version joins the same way, up to the cap of 1,535 sub-rules.
(2) The intraday census turns every in-session item into free, outcome-free cost facts: latency, IEX presence, spreads before and at the order, and the would-fill flag. A pre-registered gate reads them and registers the seat automatically, so a charge is spent only once costs are known to be payable.
(3) Cost follows information. Reads happen only where they can change a slot, plus an unbiased hash sample. The line scales with m = cap/$5. Spend stops and canaries cut what does not pay.
(4) Judged = traded throughout: late reads are missing for both shadow and money, and the intraday shadow fills only what the SIP ask allows, with COST-7's ratchets. So whatever the screen promotes is what Done counts, and Done's 15 bp item holds (gap about 0 bp).
(5) No judge or wall is edited. Every stop only removes events, so no guard can raise a false-pass rate.
events_per_session_and_cost:
READER-2 reads per session: news 40 plus a hash sample of about 20 (Haiku 4.5), and in earnings season 24 + about 8 earnings 8-Ks (Sonnet 5.5).
- Metered: $0.572/day in season and $0.203/day after (reader_cost10.out), plus canaries at about $0.04/day, inside a $0.60 x m line.
- A102 price: 3.4 sessions of Done time in season and 1.2 after, against 5.3 for the reader lens's sketch and 15.9 / 31.8 for Sonnet / Opus on the whole R2 set.
- Break-even edge, in season / after:
  | stream | in season | after |
  |---|---|---|
  | one learning seat | 18.8 bp | 6.7 bp |
  | two streams | 9.4 bp | 3.3 bp |
  | Probe | 6.0 bp | 2.1 bp |
- Records:
  - news top 14 and top 8 (supply: 54-165 READ-O1 intents a session, SPEED-FACTS);
  - earnings top 14 (18-26 ERN intents a session in season, near 0 after);
  - news avoid, up to 14;
  - earnings beat, a few;
  - the hash control, about 20-30.
- The one seat, if registered: 14 shadow events a session; 8 real buys at learning ($38 lots, about $304 a session) and 14 at Probe ($67.9 lots).

INTRADAY:
- Census: in-session single-symbol articles with an ok verdict (HOUSE-FACTS: 227-285 articles an hour in 14:00-19:00Z, about 425 a session in 10:00-15:00 ET before the filters).
- The seat: score >= 2 candidates that pass the cost filter, at most 8 real buys a session at learning; the gate requires a median of 8 or more.
- Reads: one IEX snapshot batch per turn, plus about 1 deferred SIP quote read per candidate, under the plan's 200 a minute and the 150-a-minute bucket.
- Metered: $0/day added.
- Money cost per real event: the half-spread, 8-17 bp at h0 8 and 15-32 bp at h0 15 (intraday_exec.out), plus the 0.28 bp SEC fee.
- Orders: at most 16 a session.
calibration:
Synthetic only.

(1) THE FROZEN SCREEN. screen10.py imports docs/prereg/evl-6/calib_v2.py, calib_final.py and search_final.py byte-for-byte from origin/prereg/evl-6 (4ae9017a).
- Rule: looks at blocks 22/25/30/35/40/50/60; alpha 0.020 / 0.006 / 0.001; 10 bp margin; money weights min(n, 14); top-14 and issuer guards.
- Fresh seeds from 201M (fp), 202M (bias), 203M (power) and 204M (topk); 120 sessions; runs 1 and 2. Table: screen10_table.out.
- FALSE PASSES, run 1, 2,000 programs a cell, at the grid's worst corner (t(3)-body clustered crash days, skewed events, rho .15, phi .20):
  - counts that follow the day, 3/5/8 a session: .1250/.1180/.1090 at a 10 bp drift, .1260/.1265/.1195 at 20 bp (SE about .007);
  - independent counts at 20 bp: .0840 at 8 a session, .0975 at 13;
  - every cell is <= the 0.13 charge within one SE; two runs .165-.235.
  - So both seats are carried by the frozen screen and charged 0.13.
- MIS-COSTED REPLAY (a money-null whose shadow reads +h), base / worst cell, at 8 and at 5 a session:
  | h | 8 a session | 5 a session |
  |---|---|---|
  | 10 bp | .037 / .091 | .039 / .107 |
  | 20 bp | .063 / .141 | .058 / .133 |
  | 30 bp | .106 / .185 | .099 / .170 |
  | 45 bp | .202 / .248 | .183 / .240 |
  - Two runs at h45, worst cell: .410-.418.
  - The margin absorbs about 10 bp. At h20 the rate exceeds 0.13; from h30 it exceeds 15%.
- POWER: in the design field. +60 bp at 8 a session is .265 by session 30, matching EVL-6 s4.5's .266.
- TOP-K: in the design field. P(pass) x n x edge is 25.0 for top 14 vs 19.6 for top 8 at rho .45, so the seat is top 14.

(2) EXECUTION (intraday_exec.py, passive_select.py).
- h_eff, break-even drift, the fill gap: about 0 bp against the SIP-ask replay (H1), and the full h_eff against the mid (H2).
- Passive vs marketable.

(3) LATENCY (latency10.py): from code timers plus a stated vendor lag of U(0, 30) s.

(4) READER-2 cost (reader_cost10.py): per-read dollars from evl7/reader/cost_model.out, scaled x1.092 to the measured $0.000896 a v1 verdict.

(5) SPEND STOP (futility10.py): it stops an equal reader .095-.099, a worse one .176-.197, a better one (.45) .018-.045.

(6) BUDGET (budget10.py).

(7) EV (ev10.py). The priors are the red team's judgment:
- READER-2 seat edge -15/0/+20/+30/+60 bp with probabilities .20/.35/.22/.15/.08;
- intraday edge net of the ask -30/-15/0/+20/+30/+60 bp with probabilities .20/.25/.25/.15/.10/.05.

LIMITS:
- Spreads, widening and drift are assumptions; the census measures the cost side of them.
- calib_v2 ranks in draw order.
- topk_edge is an order-statistics model, not a reader.
prereg_clauses:
## RT. The red team's clauses, for PREREG-EVL-10 and -11. [Cn] names the cause each one closes.

RT-0 ZERO CHARGE FIRST [C5, C10].
- Every rule is registered first as a FREE RECORD.
- At most ONE seat per file. A seat registers only if R3's validator room left after every waiting run, every registered birth AND its own 0.13 is >= 0.39.
- On budget10.out: one EVL-10 seat only if EVL-10 registers before A104's births, and no EVL-11 seat at its freeze.
- Every seat:
  - is judged by PREREG-EVL-6 ss1-3 AS FROZEN;
  - is charged 0.13 a run when the run starts;
  - counts only events knowable after its own registration;
  - trades real money at learning from its first event, with a full-size shadow;
  - takes EVL-6 s6's Probe band (14 open, at-size buys).

### PREREG-EVL-10 (READER-2)

RT-R.1 THE SLOT SUBSET [C3]. Reads only:
- (a) news_open: the top 40 of the window's control by (ok v1 PROMPT-NEWS score desc, h asc), plus every other candidate with h < 1/16 (THE HASH SAMPLE, at most 24). h(e) = int(sha256("R2|"+e)[:8]) / 2^64.
- (b) item-2.02 filings: the top 24 by (ok v1 PROMPT-DOC score desc, h asc), plus h < 1/8 (at most 8).
- Nothing else: no T2 cascade and no Opus.
- Models: (a) claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 at temperature 0; (b) claude-sonnet-5-5 at effort low. Texts and schemas are the READER-2 designer's, frozen here.
- LINE: $0.60 a UTC day x m, with m = cap/$5 in [1, 5]. v1's $1.00 reserve stands. A read whose worst-case hold does not fit is missing.

RT-R.2 JUDGED = TRADED [C7]. A read answered after 09:12:00 ET of D is MISSING for the shadow and for money alike; the shadow never waits.

RT-R.3 PIN AND CANARIES [C8].
- THE PIN:
  - Every answer stores the response `model` string, and the smoke test (about $0.05, before the first read) pins it.
  - A mismatch is stored `refused` and stops that tier for good.
- THE CANARIES:
  - 12 synthetic items with fictitious unlisted issuers, frozen here: 8 news items to (a) and 4 filings to (b), asked at 07:05 ET each session.
  - The smoke test asks each one 3 times. Tolerance = max(15 p_up points, twice the range of the 3 answers) and the modal categorical values.
- THE STOP: a tier stops when 3 or more canaries fall outside tolerance on two consecutive sessions, or 2 or more answers in a UTC day fail the schema. Its fields are missing from then on, and the reader_drift alarm fires.
- The R2-J fallback is pinned before the first read.

RT-R.4 SPEND STOP [C3]. It is forward-only and never moves a band.
- At the 40th and the 60th session holding >= 20 settled TRADABLE hash-sample events:
  - compute dIC_s = within-session Spearman IC(p_up, a) - IC(v1 score, a), on control outcomes settled and stored before the computation;
  - if mean + 1.2816 x sd / sqrt(sessions) < 0, the tier stops for good; tier (b) the same on its own sample.
- It only removes events.

RT-R.5 RECORDS. They are free, hold 1, open of D to close of D, and decided INSIDE the receipt `decide-open:<D>`, so each is an EVL-META-O1 SOURCE under PREREG-EVL-8 s7.2 at no charge [C5].
- Limit at entry: 1.25 x the previous SIP close. One event per issuer per D. TRADABLE.
- REC-R2-NEWS-TOP14-O1: (a) with an ok read by 09:12, price_story false, new >= 1, type not in {price_move, opinion, sector_macro, ownership}; the top 14 by p_up, then surprise, then h.
- REC-R2-NEWS-TOP8-O1: the same rule, top 8.
- REC-R2-NEWS-AVOID-O1: EVL-NEWS-READ-O1 v3's events, minus issuers read price_story true, new = 0 or p_up <= 40; the top 14 by (v1 score, adv20, id).
- REC-R2-ERN-TOP14-O1: (b) with routine false, dilution false, guide_action not lowered/withdrawn and res_vs_guide not below; the top 14 by p_up.
- REC-R2-ERN-BEAT-O1: (b) with res_vs_guide above or guide raised, routine false and dilution false; at most 14.
- REC-R2-HASH-O1: the hash sample; RT-R.4's population.

RT-R.6 THE ONE SEAT, under RT-0: EVL-R2-NEWS-TOP14-O1 v1, REC-R2-NEWS-TOP14-O1's rule, seatable at learning.
- The shadow is the top 14. Money takes them in rank order through ROOM after every PREREG-EVL-1 to -9 row and before births: 8 at learning, 14 at Probe.
- Control: EVL-CTRL-NEWS-ALL-O1 v1.
- Measured false passes: 0.0975 +- 0.0066 per run at 13 a session at the worst corner (screen10.fp).

RT-R.7 META HEADROOM [C5]. Births-at-scale's free records may take at most half of each META family's headroom at EVL-10's registration: about 610 sub-rules for O1 and 365 for ON below the cap of 1,535.

### PREREG-EVL-11 (intraday)

RT-I.1 CENSUS. INTRA-CENSUS-1 is a free record with no order and no new model call [C2, C4, C6, C9].
- CANDIDATES: ENEWS articles with exactly one symbol (an eligible issuer), received_at in [09:40, 14:45) ET of D, with an ok PROMPT-NEWS verdict of any score. The first such article per issuer per D. No 8-K.
- KNOWABLE: received_at. t_d = max(received_at, answered_at) + 60 s.
- STORED WRITE-ONCE:
  - the IEX latestQuote, read live at the first lane turn after max(received_at, answered_at);
  - after t_d + 16 min: the SIP NBBO at t_d - 16 min, at t_d and at t_d + 2 s; the SPY/IWM mid at t_d + 2 s; and the would-fill flag.
- OUTCOME: a = close print / (SIP ask at t_d + 2 s) x (1 - 0.28e-4) - 1 - (benchmark close / benchmark mid at t_d + 2 s - 1).
  - It is read only by the seat's screen, after the seat's own registration.
  - No gate, designer or birth reads it.
- SIP reads are deferred under the 150-a-minute bucket; at night if needed.

RT-I.2 SEAT TEXT, INTRA-NEWS-IOC-1 v1, frozen now and registered only by RT-I.3.
- EVENTS: census candidates with score >= 2 that pass the COST FILTER:
  - an IEX quote with half-spread <= 25 bp;
  - a SIP NBBO half-spread at t_d - 16 min <= 10 bp;
  - an IEX ask <= 1.03 x the SIP last trade at t_d - 16 min;
  - TRADABLE, with one position per issuer and A72's cooldown.
- RANK: v1 score desc, then IEX half-spread asc, then adv20 desc, then id.
- ENTRY: one IOC limit buy at t_d, limit = min(IEX ask x 1.003, 1.25 x the previous SIP close), whole shares, never after 14:45 ET.
- EXIT: the closing cross of D.
- REPLAY: the SIP ask at t_d + 2 s, taken only when it is <= the limit, plus COST-7 (EVL-7 s2) with M and G computed over this seat's own IOC attempts (real_attempts, tif 'ioc'). Never the mid, the last trade or IEX.
- CONTROL: INTRA-CTRL-1, a free record: census candidates of every score that pass the same filter.
- MONEY GUARDS:
  - cost <= 09:00 ET cash - D's filled and working buys - A85's close reservations;
  - ROOM after every PREREG row;
  - two switches: STOCK_INTRADAY_BUYS (default off) and equity_money.intraday.enabled;
  - the seat stops for the day on a refusal;
  - at most 8 IOC buys a session at learning, 14 at Probe.
- Charged 0.13 at registration.

RT-I.3 THE GATE. The House runs it with no captain step, from EX-ANTE costs and counts only. At the first close at which all of these hold:
- G1: >= 15 census sessions and >= 300 candidates;
- G2: median SIP half-spread at t_d + 2 s <= 10 bp over score >= 2 filter-passers, and a median of >= 8 of them a session;
- G3: p90 of t_d - created_at <= 240 s;
- G4: an IEX quote present for >= 70% of candidates;
- G5: would-fill >= 95%;
- G6: room per RT-0.

The House then registers the seat through the docs route, as births are registered. If the gate has not opened by the census's 40th session, the seat lapses and is never charged.

RT-I.4 NEVER:
- a passive or resting entry;
- a timed marketable exit;
- an 8-K;
- a move-conditioned trigger alone;
- a second intraday seat.
harness_changes:
H-RT1 READER-2 READ STEP. Files: league/events/reader2.py (new), house.py (a reader step), store.py (additive tables reads2 and canaries).
- Reads RT-R.1's slot subset inside a $0.60 x m line, keeping v1's $1 reserve.

risks: THE RED TEAM'S OWN BET. Records-first routes READER-2's value through EVL-8's meta-learner, which finds a +40 / +60 bp sub-rule 0.207 / 0.657 of the time within 120 sessions (EVL-8 s0). If EVL-8 slips or never freezes, the records reach no money, and RT-R.6's one seat is the only money path.

THE PRIORS IN ev10.py ARE JUDGMENT, NOT DATA. The verdict would flip if intraday drift remaining after 90-170 s commonly exceeded h_eff + 60 bp in names with a half-spread of 10 bp or less. The census measures only the cost side; only the seat's screen can measure the drift.
RT-I.3's GATE MAY NEVER OPEN. Liquid names are where HFT is fastest (C4's trap), so the intraday lane may stay a census forever and never trade. That costs nothing, but the owner should know.
THE CENSUS'S IEX READ IS LIVE. Quote presence and spread at t_d cannot be reconstructed later, so a missed turn loses that candidate. G1 counts only candidates that have a read.

REGISTRATION BY RULE is a registration the House writes, and the tag push must never touch a judge. The gate's timing correlates with calm, low-spread regimes. That is harmless under the screen's stationary null, but it is a regime dependence and is stated as one.

THE SPEND STOP IS WEAK. It stops a worse reader at most 0.197 of the time and an equal one about 0.10. The real guard is the small line: a worse reader costs at most about $11 over the earnings season ($0.572 a day for 20 sessions).

CANARY FALSE STOPS. Sonnet 5.5 samples (it takes no temperature), so if the smoke test's 3 answers understate its range, a healthy tier can be stopped. The stop only removes events, and the report shows its cause.
META HEADROOM. Births at scale could fill EVL-META-ON's remaining 365 sub-rules within weeks. RT-R.7's half-share must be written into the births design.

SETTLED CASH IS NOT READ BY CODE TODAY. A wrong computation either starves the seat or risks a good-faith violation. Many brokers restrict an account to settled cash for 90 days after 3 violations in 12 months; this is a general rule, not verified for Alpaca, and it would affect every row of the lane, so the guard errs toward starving.
DEPLOY WINDOW. READER-2's reads run 11:30-13:12Z, straddling the 12:55Z block, so it ships in an evening window. Its first morning is a reads-only pass, with records only.

CORRELATED PASSES. The seat's events are a subset of EVL-NEWS-READ-O1 v3's, so a family drift (EVL-6's N2+ case: 0.122-0.163) passes both seats together. Done's issuer-block bound and realized P&L remain the backstop.
